Carlos (Finance): Marcus from Lantus just emailed — says April invoice surged and they suspect retries. Asking if we can show whether retries were double-billed. Can Billing/Gateway confirm? /cc @Jasmin @Ilya
Jasmin (Billing Ops): Pulling ledger vs ingest. Do we have a quick metric for "requests with retry flag" vs billed_units?
Billing Bot: invoice=2026-04 customer_id=lantus billed_embed_units=4,210,400 billable_amount=$1,602.54
Ilya (Gateway): We log idempotency-key header when present. Gateway rollout 2026-04-02 made header optional for some legacy clients; missing header causes gateway to forward retries as new requests. Investigating logs for Lantus tenant.
Priya (SRE): Running a targeted query across gateway logs and metering join to find duplicate request_ids within 10s window:
```
SELECT g.request_id, g.idempotency_key, COUNT(m.request_id) as metered_count
FROM gateway.requests g
LEFT JOIN metering.events m ON g.trace_id = m.trace_id
WHERE g.customer_id='lantus' AND g.event_time >= '2026-04-01' AND g.event_time <= '2026-04-30'
GROUP BY g.request_id, g.idempotency_key
HAVING COUNT(m.request_id) > 1
ORDER BY metered_count DESC
LIMIT 5;
```
Ilya (Gateway): Results: ~1,020 requests with identical payloads that were metered twice; idempotency_key was NULL for those. Example: request_id=gw-9a1, payload_hash=sha256:abc123, metered_count=2.
Jasmin (Billing Ops): Can we translate that to embed units? Need delta units attributable to double-metering and $ impact.
Priya (SRE): Quick joins show those duplicate requests totalled ~412,800 embed_units.
Jasmin (Billing Ops): Lantus is on negotiated embed rate $0.00038/unit. Delta = 412,800 * 0.00038 = $157.26.
Marcus (CS): Lantus customer is sensitive to overbilling. Recommend full refund for the delta and a note explaining the gateway optional-header change.
Carlos (Finance): Approve refund for $160 (round up) as a goodwill adjustment. Also request a permanent change: gateway must refuse requests missing idempotency_key when client signals retry semantics, or should synthesize a dedup key from payload+client_id.
Ilya (Gateway): Agreed. I will push GW-9483: "idempotency: synthesize key when missing for POST /embed and dedupe in gateway". We'll also add a safe-path to drop duplicates within 30s for customers that opt-in.
Jasmin (Billing Ops): Will issue credit and include CSV evidence of duplicate trace_ids and the delta calculation. Billing Bot: credit_queued customer=lantus invoice=2026-04 amount=$160 ref=RL-2005432100 status=queued
Priya (SRE): Also adding monitoring: per-tenant duplicate_metered_rate > 0.5% sustained for 1h triggers P1 paging to gateway oncall. Filing SRE-3348.
Marcus (CS): I'll send the customer note: apology, explanation of gateway header change, credit applied, and next steps to prevent recurrence (idempotency enforcement + opt-in dedupe).
Carlos (Finance): Good. Jasmin, attach the GW ticket and SRE ticket to the invoice note so audit trail exists.
Billing Bot: credit_applied customer=lantus invoice=2026-04 amount=$160 ref=RL-2005432100 status=applied
Jasmin (Billing Ops): Done. Also running a sweep to see if other tenants were affected; will post results in #finance later today.
Priya (SRE): Sweep initial numbers: detected similar double-metering pattern for 7 tenants, total estimated delta ~1.9M embed_units across April. Will handover list to Billing for batch credits if approved.
Carlos (Finance): Let's treat these case-by-case. For deltas < $250 we can auto-credit; above that escalate to finance sign-off. Thanks team.
